definitions.explanation: Relating to the ordinary world rather than religious or spiritual matters. Can describe things that are commonplace, materialistic, or concerned with everyday human affairs.

examples.japanese: {世俗的|せぞくてき}な{価値観|かちかん}。
{彼|かれ}は{世俗的|せぞくてき}な{欲望|よくぼう}に{関心|かんしん}がない。
examples.english: He has no interest in worldly desires.

examples.japanese: {出家|しゅっけ}して{世俗的|せぞくてき}な{生活|せいかつ}から{離|はな}れた。
examples.english: He entered the priesthood and left behind worldly life.

notes:
Formed from {世俗|せぞく} (the secular world) + {的|てき} (adjective suffix). Can be used neutrally to mean "secular" (as opposed to religious), or with a slightly negative nuance to mean "mundane" or "materialistic."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な{価値観|かちかん} — worldly values
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な{欲望|よくぼう} — worldly desires
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な{生活|せいかつ} — secular/worldly life
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な{成功|せいこう} — worldly success

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {俗世|ぞくせ} — the secular world
- {現世|げんせ} — this world, the present world
- {世間的|せけんてき} — in terms of public opinion, socially
